blocks.text: Organic compounds ke chemical reactions complex (pecheeda) hote hain. Inhein gehrai se samajhne ke liye hum yeh basic baatein samne rakh kar aage barhte hain:

items: Covalent bond do tareeqon se toot sakta hai: homolytic aur heterolytic.
Reagents basically teen types ke hain: free radicals, electrophiles aur nucleophiles.
Organic reactions ki kai aam types hain (neeche saat di gayi hain).

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab yahan aur “C. Types of Organic Reactions” mein reactions ki “chaar” types kehti hai, lekin aage saat types (i–vii) batati hai: substitution, addition, elimination, hydrolysis, condensation, oxidation aur reduction.
